title: Early Phase Indian National Congress
definition: The formative period of the Indian National Congress (1885–1905), characterized by the leadership of Moderate nationalists who relied on constitutional methods, prayer, petition, and protest.
importanceInUpsc: Crucial for both Prelims (chronology, founders, early sessions, economic critique) and Mains (GS Paper 1: Modern Indian History - Freedom Struggle, contributions and limitations of Moderates).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts, objectives, and methods of the early Indian National Congress.
Evaluate the Moderate ideology, economic critique of British rule, and constitutional demands.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions on early Congress leaders and sessions.
prerequisites: Rise of Nationalism in 19th Century India
